Use Case: Basic.source:
usecase-beta
    actor Admin
    actor Customer
    systemBoundary Shop
        Browse
        Checkout
        Pay[Pay by card]
    end
    Customer --> Browse
    Customer --> Checkout
    Checkout ..> : include Pay
    Admin --"manages"--> Browse
    note for Checkout "needs login"

Use Case: Relationships.source:
usecase-beta
    actor User
    actor Admin
    Admin --|> User
    systemBoundary Library
        Search(Search catalogue)
        Borrow(Borrow a book)
        Reserve
        Renew
        Fine(Pay a fine)
    end
    User -- Search
    User --> Borrow
    Borrow ..> : include Reserve
    Renew ..> : extend Borrow
    Admin <-- Fine
    Borrow -- late return --> Fine

Use Case: Top To Bottom.source:
usecase-beta
    direction TB
    actor "Support agent"
    actor Customer(Customer)
    systemBoundary "Help desk"
        Open[Open a ticket]
        Reply(Reply to a ticket)
        Close
    end
    Customer --> Open
    "Support agent" --> Reply
    "Support agent" --> Close
    Reply ..> : include Close

Use Case: Notes.source:
usecase-beta
    actor Guest
    Book
    Cancel(Cancel a booking)
    Guest --> Book
    Book ..> : include Cancel
    note for Guest "May be anonymous"
